# StreamDek Mobile v2.2.2

Emby joins Plex and Jellyfin, StreamDek can reach for your own servers first when you press Play,
and you can now choose the font StreamDek is set in. Add-ons, title pages and StreamDek Fuse are
quicker and tidier too.

## What's New

**Emby**
Connect your own Emby server and its films and series join Home, Search and the media page, beside
Plex and Jellyfin. Servers on your network are found by themselves, or enter the address you open
Emby at in a browser. Sign in with your Emby username and password, or with **Emby Connect** to pick
from the servers linked to your emby.media account. Your emby.media password is used once and never
kept.
- Add more than one Emby server, switch libraries on or off, and choose whether Emby's in-progress
  titles also appear in StreamDek's Continue Watching.
- Emby is kept with your StreamDek profile, so your other devices and your TV get your servers too.
- The Emby page has its own soft green glow, which you can switch off like Plex's and Jellyfin's.

**Prefer Media Server Source**
A new setting. Turn it on and, when you press Play without choosing a source, StreamDek looks to
your own Plex, Jellyfin and Emby servers first:
- **Direct Play** from your servers first, then **Direct Stream**, then the best source from your
  add-ons and plugins. A server copy that would need converting is kept for choosing by hand.
- A copy that plays well on this phone beats a bigger one that would not.
- A source you chose yourself, or asked StreamDek to remember, still comes first.

**App Font**
Choose the typeface StreamDek uses everywhere in **Settings > Appearance and Language >
Typography**. Keep your phone's own font, which is the default, or switch to **StreamDek Sans**,
StreamDek's own clean, modern typeface, drawn in six real weights. Each option is previewed in its
own font, the change applies straight away, and your choice follows your account to your other
devices and your TV.

**In-App Action Notifications**
A new switch under **Notifications** in **Settings > Appearance and Language**. It is off, so the
small confirmations for routine actions - refreshing content, managing your media servers, updating
settings - no longer pop up every time. Turn it on to see them again. Errors, and anything that needs
you to act, are always shown.

## Improvements

**Your servers' copies, everywhere**
A film or episode from StreamDek's catalogue now also lists the copies on your own servers among its
sources, and a title opened from your server lists your add-on sources too. Whichever you play, your
progress is saved to your server as well as to StreamDek.

**Continue Watching where you want it**
Choose for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby apart whether titles you are part-way through appear only on the
server's own page or also in StreamDek's Continue Watching row.

**Your server order, on every device**
The order you put your servers and libraries in now follows your profile to your other phones and
to your TV, instead of staying on this device.

**Resuming from your servers**
Resuming a title from Continue Watching now asks your server for a fresh link every time, so titles
that stalled on resume start playing again.

**The media page remembers where you were**
Coming back to the Plex, Jellyfin or Emby page from a title or another tab now returns you to the
same place instead of the top of the page.

**Every version on a Plex server**
When a Plex server holds more than one version of a title, each is now offered, so a version that
plays directly on this phone is never hidden behind one that does not.

**Your servers in the navigation bar**
With more than one kind of media server connected, the media tab now shows each service's mark
together - two side by side, or three in a cluster - so you can tell at a glance what it opens.

**Cards that match their add-on**
Home rows and StreamDek Fuse catalogs from add-ons and plugins now show their cards in the shape the
add-on asks for - poster, square or landscape.

**StreamDek Fuse keeps your place**
Coming back to StreamDek Fuse after watching a live channel now returns you to the catalog and view
you were on, instead of starting again.

**Quicker add-on changes**
Removing an add-on, or taking it out of your favourites, now happens the moment you tap instead of
after a long wait.

**Quicker title pages**
A title's details from your add-ons and from TMDB are now fetched together rather than one after the
other, and titles you opened recently open straight away.

**A backdrop for every title**
Holding down a card for a title with no artwork now shows a soft, blurred ambient background behind
its actions, instead of a plain one. A card with no artwork at all shows the title's first letter.

## Quick Setup

- **Emby:** open **Settings > Sources > Emby**, pick your server from the list or enter its address,
  then sign in with your username and password or with **Emby Connect**.
- **Prefer Media Server Source:** switch it on in Settings. It is off until you do, so playback works
  as before.
- **Continue Watching location:** open **Settings > Sources > Plex**, **Jellyfin** or **Emby** and
  choose where that server's in-progress titles appear.
- **App Font:** **Settings > Appearance and Language > Typography**.
- **In-App Action Notifications:** **Settings > Appearance and Language > Notifications**.

## Good to Know

- Emby has no Quick Connect, so sign in with your password or Emby Connect. A server added through
  Emby Connect must be reachable from your phone.
- With **Prefer Media Server Source** on, StreamDek waits a few seconds at most for your servers when
  you press Play. A server that is slow or offline is skipped, and your add-ons and plugins play
  instead.
- Your TV follows your server order from StreamDek TV v0.4.0. An order you set before this update
  reaches your other devices the first time this version opens.
- StreamDek Sans covers Latin text. Other scripts and emoji appear in your phone's own font.
